newsitem.title: USA: Stocks jump as traders hope for status-quo in Washington.
newsitem.headline: Stocks jump as traders hope for status-quo in Washington.

text.p: Stocks prices jumped Tuesday as Wall Street, hoping for the status-quo in Washington following the national elections, threw an early victory celebration.

Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow Jones industrial average ended up 39.50 points at 6,081.18, while the Standard & Poor's composite index of 500 stocks rose 7.41 points to a new high close of 714.14, beating the old milestone of 710.82.
In the broader market, advancing issues led declines 14-9 on active volume of 488 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
